instructions.description: Performs element-wise addition of 16 single-precision (32-bit) floating-point numbers from zmm2 and zmm3/m512, storing the result in zmm1 with optional masking and zeroing.
instructions.source_db: Intel Architecture Instruction Set Extensions Reference

instructions.description: Performs element-wise addition of 8 single-precision floating-point numbers from ymm2 and ymm3/m256, storing the result in ymm1.
instructions.source_db: Intel Architecture Instruction Set Extensions Reference

instructions.summary: Fused Multiply-Add of Packed Single-Precision (zmm1 = (zmm2 * zmm3) + zmm1)
instructions.description: Multiplies packed single-precision float elements in zmm2 with zmm3/m512, adds zmm1, and stores the result back in zmm1 with a single rounding step.
instructions.source_db: Intel Architecture Instruction Set Extensions Reference

instructions.summary: Fused Multiply-Add 213 Packed Single (ymm1 = (ymm1 * ymm3) + ymm2)
instructions.description: Multiplies packed single-precision floats in ymm1 and ymm3, adds ymm2, and stores result in ymm1.
instructions.source_db: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual

instructions.description: Performs element-wise integer addition of 8 doubleword (32-bit) integers in ymm2 and ymm3, storing sums in ymm1.
instructions.source_db: Intel Architecture Instruction Set Extensions Reference

instructions.summary: Broadcast Single-Precision Floating-Point Value to 256-bit YMM
instructions.description: Loads a 32-bit float from memory and duplicates it into all 8 elements of ymm1.
instructions.source_db: Intel Architecture Instruction Set Extensions Reference

instructions.summary: Gather Packed Single-Precision Floats Using 32-bit Indices
instructions.description: Gathers 8 float values from non-contiguous memory locations using a vector base address and vector offset indices.
instructions.source_db: Intel Architecture Instruction Set Extensions Reference

instructions.summary: Detect Conflicts Within a Vector of Packed 32-bit Integers
instructions.description: Tests each element of zmm2 against preceding elements for equality and generates a bitmask in zmm1 for collision-free loop vectorization.

instructions.summary: Multiply Packed 64-bit Integers and Store Low 64-bit Result
instructions.description: Performs 8 parallel 64-bit integer multiplications across 512-bit ZMM registers.
Loads or stores 64 packed 8-bit bytes into ZMM registers with byte-granularity masking.
Performs 4 parallel 32-bit single-precision float additions in 128-bit XMM registers.
Computes a cyclic redundancy check (CRC) checksum for 32-bit data and accumulates it into the destination register using Castagnoli polynomial.

instructions.summary: Return the Count of Number of Bits Set to 1
instructions.description: Counts the number of bits set to 1 in the second operand (source) and stores the count in the first operand (destination).
instructions.affected_flags: ZF is set to 1 if source operand is 0; OF, SF, ZF, AF, CF, PF are updated
instructions.source_db: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual

instructions.summary: Zero High Bits Starting with Specified Bit Position
instructions.description: Copies bits from source to destination, and clears all bits starting at the index specified in the low 8 bits of the index register.
instructions.affected_flags: CF is set if the index is greater than or equal to operand size; ZF, SF, OF, AF, PF cleared
instructions.source_db: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual

instructions.description: Inverts bits of first operand, performs bitwise AND with second operand, and writes result to destination without modifying flags incorrectly.
instructions.affected_flags: SF, ZF updated; OF, CF cleared
instructions.source_db: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual

instructions.summary: Rotate Right Logical Without Affecting Flags
instructions.description: Rotates operand right by immediate value without altering CPU status flags.
Moves the source operand to the destination if the condition Greater (signed) is met based on EFLAGS.
instructions.source_db: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual

instructions.description: Computes the effective memory address of the second operand and stores it in the destination register without accessing memory.
instructions.source_db: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual

instructions.description: Adds corresponding single-precision floating-point elements in the four 32-bit lanes of vectors v1 and v2, and places the results in vector v0.
Multiplies floating-point elements in vector vn by vm and accumulates the results into vd.
Adds floating-point numbers in active lanes of vectors z1 and z2 governed by predicate register p0, storing results in z0.
Initializes a predicate register with true values matching the vector length configuration.
Returns the value in xn if the condition code is true; otherwise returns the value in xm.
Performs 4-way unsigned 8-bit integer dot products across vector lanes and accumulates 32-bit sums into destination vector vd.

instructions.summary: Atomic Add on Memory and Load Original Value
instructions.description: Atomically loads a 64-bit value from memory location [xn], adds value from register xs, and writes the new sum back to memory while storing original value into xt.
Performs element-wise addition of active elements in vector register vs2 and vs1 under mask vm, writing elements to destination vector vd.
Multiplies elements in vs1 and vs2 and adds them into vd vector register.
Counts the number of set bits (1s) in register rs1 and writes the result to rd.

instructions.summary: Shift Left by 1 and Add (rd = (rs1 << 1) + rs2)
instructions.description: Computes indexed memory address by shifting rs1 by 1 and adding base rs2.
